english.note: Use 廢物 when stressing that an object or material is useless or has no value, rather than simply calling it rubbish.
Use this specifically for a person or thing regarded as useless or worthless, rather than for physical rubbish.

examples.english: This old phone is complete trash; it won't even turn on.
examples.traditional: 呢部舊電話直頭係廢物，連開機都開唔到。
examples.jyutping: ni1 bou6 gau6 din6 waa2 zik6 tau4 hai6 fai3 mat6 lin4 hoi1 gei1 dou1 hoi1 m4 dou2

examples.english: They are always late—they are really garbage.
examples.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ci4 dou3 zan1 hai6 fai3 mat6
